title: Verification entry
description: One entry of the evidence-verifier agent's output. The CLI also accepts the camelCase spelling of every field name (candidateId, evidenceQuality, technicalConfidence, fixVerdict, fixConfidence, fixReason, fixDirection, impactTraced, premisesVerified, requiredContextMissing, partlyAddressed). Keep the checks in `verificationProblem` in src/cli.ts in step with this file.

verified.description: The verifier's verdict on the claim. false rejects anything but a question; such a candidate reaches scoring only to be listed as unverified when blocking context was missing.

premises_verified.description: For a question: whether the facts it rests on hold. A question is eligible without a verified answer, but not when this is false.

required_context_missing.description: Context the verifier needed and could not obtain. A string, or an object without `kind`, is blocking: the claim depends on it and cannot ship. `cosmetic` context would only sharpen the wording, and does not hold the claim back.

partly_addressed.description: Only for a candidate whose possibleRepeatOf is the owner's own comment, when the author fixed part of what that comment raised and part is still open. remaining lists the open points, addressed the fixed ones.
